summary: We report a fiber-optic laser-pump neutron-probe method for momentum- and frequency-resolved magneto-optical measurements. The technique uses inelastic neutron scattering to measure time-dependent two-point magnetization correlations, S(Q,$ω$), after resonant photoexcitation at cryogenic temperatures. We demonstrate it by measuring nonequilibrium thermalization dynamics in Yb-based quantum magnets.

AI.tldr: 报道一种光纤激光泵浦—中子探测方法，可在低温下实现动量与频率分辨的磁光测量，用非弹性中子散射测量共振光激发后的时间分辨两点磁化关联S(Q,ω)，并在Yb基量子磁体中演示了非平衡热化动力学。
AI.motivation: 现有泵浦—探测手段（如光学、X射线）多缺乏对动量空间的直接分辨能力，难以获取光激发后磁关联的完整信息，需要一种兼具动量与频率分辨、且能在低温运行的磁激发探测方案。
AI.method: 采用光纤将激光引入低温样品环境实现共振光激发（泵浦），以非弹性中子散射作为探测手段，测量时间依赖的两点磁化关联函数S(Q,ω)，从而在动量Q与频率ω上分辨非平衡磁响应。
AI.result: 在Yb基量子磁体中成功观测到光激发后的非平衡热化动力学，验证了该泵浦—探测方案的可行性与分辨能力。
AI.conclusion: 光纤激光泵浦—中子探测为动量、频率分辨的时间分辨磁光研究提供了通用平台，可拓展至量子磁体非平衡态与热化过程的研究。

title: Online Scheduling for Entanglement Distillation: Learning When to Wait
summary: Entanglement distillation probabilistically increases the fidelity of entangled pairs at the cost of reducing their number. The outcome of each distillation operation takes time to communicate, during which the entangled pairs decohere while idle in their memories. This raises a dilemma: wait for the outcome before proceeding, or continue optimistically at the risk of needlessly consuming further pairs. We study online distillation scheduling, in which distillation trees are constructed dynamically to maximize the throughput of pairs that meet a required fidelity. A policy decides which pairs to distill together and, for each operation, whether to wait for its outcome. We derive an upper bound on the throughput of every scheduling policy and, by formulating the problem as a Markov decision process, train, with reinforcement learning, a policy that applies to any number of memories. Compared with two baselines that always or never wait, the learned policy delivers as many pairs of the required fidelity as the better one when one of these two extremes is the best choice, and more otherwise.

AI.tldr: 研究纠缠蒸馏的在线调度问题：动态构造蒸馏树，并逐次决定每个操作是否等待结果，以最大化满足保真度要求的纠缠对吞吐量。将该问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程并用强化学习训练适用于任意内存数目的策略。
AI.motivation: 纠缠蒸馏以牺牲纠缠对数量为代价提升保真度，而每次蒸馏结果需时间通信，等待期间空闲纠缠对发生退相干。由此产生"等待结果"与"乐观继续（可能浪费纠缠对）"之间的权衡，且现有做法缺乏对此的优化调度。
AI.method: 推导任意调度策略吞吐量的上界；将在线蒸馏调度建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），用强化学习训练一个策略，该策略决定哪些对一起蒸馏以及每个操作是否等待结果，并可推广到任意数量的内存。
AI.result: 与"总是等待"和"从不等待"两个基线相比，所学策略在某一极端为最优时能达到较优基线相同的达标纠缠对数量，在其他情形下则优于两者。
AI.conclusion: 在线自适应调度（动态决定是否等待）能够超越固定等待策略，强化学习给出可跨内存规模泛化的近优调度策略，且吞吐量上界为性能评估提供基准。

title: Universal stabilizer correlations in chaotic eigenstates
summary: Entanglement and nonstabilizerness provide complementary perspectives on quantum-state structure. In this work, we find that the stabilizer correlation, defined as the difference between the Rényi-$2$ mutual information and the mutual stabilizer Rényi entropy, approaches a universal constant for chaotic eigenstates. This constant is determined solely by the symmetries, and quantifies the correlation that does not contribute to nonstabilizerness. We identify this universal stabilizer correlation analytically via random-state ensembles, which give $\log_2 7$ (GOE) and $\log_2 4$(GUE) without extra symmetries, $\log_2 14$ and $\log_2 8$ under spin-inversion parity or half-filling magnetization. While imposing reflection or translation symmetry leaves these values unchanged. Exact calculations for a chaotic mixed-field Ising chain confirm the predicted plateau and finite-size approach. Integrable free-fermion and strongly disordered eigenstates behave qualitatively differently. This universal stabilizer correlation reveals a characteristic structure of chaotic eigenstates beyond entanglement or nonstabilizerness alone.

AI.tldr: 本文发现混沌本征态中"稳定子关联"（Rényi-2互信息与互稳定子Rényi熵之差）趋于仅由对称性决定的普适常数，并借助随机态系综解析给出具体数值，揭示混沌本征态超越纠缠与nonstabilizerness的结构特征。
AI.motivation: 纠缠与非稳定化度（nonstabilizerness）分别刻画量子态结构的不同侧面，但二者的联合信息如何区分混沌、可积与强无序本征态尚不清楚，缺少一个能够刻画"非稳定化度之外的关联"的定量指标。
AI.method: 定义稳定子关联量为 Rényi-2 互信息与互稳定子 Rényi 熵之差；通过随机态系综（GOE/GUE 及带对称性约束的系综）解析求出其普适值；并在混沌混合场 Ising 链上做精确对角化验证，同时对比可积自由费米子与强无序本征态。
AI.result: 无额外对称性时普适值为 log₂7（GOE）与 log₂4（GUE）；在自旋反转宇称或半填充磁化约束下为 log₂14 与 log₂8；反射或平移对称性不改变该值。混合场 Ising 链的精确计算证实了预测的平台及有限尺寸趋近行为，而可积自由费米子与强无序本征态表现出定性的不同行为。
AI.conclusion: 稳定子关联对混沌本征态给出仅依赖对称性的普适常数，可作为区分混沌、可积与强无序态的判据，揭示了混沌态在纠缠与 nonstabilizerness 之外的特征结构。

title: Nonequilibrium Dynamics of R-loop Formation in the CRISPR-Cas9 System
summary: The binding specificity of CRISPR-Cas9 is governed by the stepwise formation of an R-loop, in which the sgRNA displaces the nontarget DNA strand and hybridizes with the target strand in discrete base pair steps. Here we develop a nonequilibrium dynamics framework that models R-loop formation as a continuous-time Markov birth-death process over twenty base pairs. Each transition rate is derived from Eyring transition-state theory and the Bell model, and combines three physical contributions, i.e., the torsional strain generated by the B-form to A-form helical conversion at the unwinding front, a base stacking correction that couples neighboring base pairs, and the allosteric work supplied by Cas9 conformational changes. We further derive the entropy production of the process, which is decomposed into activation, stacking, torsional, and allosteric terms. The resulting prediction model uses no external thermodynamic database and reaches Spearman correlations of 0.84 and 0.82 in two independent libraries of dCas9-sgRNA mismatch variants measured in vivo. The mismatch-type dependence is carried by one twist deviation and one pairing weight per type. Our model recovers the seed region sensitivity, the PAM-proximal activity gradient, and the moderate cost of dDrG mismatches, while isolating the high-activity double mismatch tail as the regime in which the present free-energy mapping is inadequate. The framework gives quantitative predictions on how DNA supercoiling and sequence context modulate binding affinity, and provides a mechanistic basis for sgRNA design.

AI.tldr: 将CRISPR-Cas9的R-loop形成建模为20个碱基对上的连续时间Markov生灭过程，速率由Eyring过渡态理论与Bell模型给出，并综合扭转应变、碱基堆积修正与Cas9别构功三项贡献；模型无需外部热力学数据库，在两个独立dCas9-sgRNA错配文库中Spearman相关达0.84与0.82。
AI.motivation: CRISPR-Cas9的结合特异性由R-loop的逐步形成决定，但现有自由能加和式预测模型多依赖经验参数或外部热力学数据，缺乏对逐碱基配对动力学机制的物理刻画，难以解释种子区敏感性、PAM近端活性梯度等系统性规律。
AI.method: 构建非平衡动力学框架，把R-loop形成表述为20个碱基对状态空间上的连续时间Markov生灭（birth-death）过程。每个跃迁速率由Eyring过渡态理论结合Bell模型导出，包含三项物理贡献：解链前沿B型→A型螺旋转换产生的扭转应变、耦合相邻碱基对的碱基堆积修正、以及Cas9构象变化提供的别构功。进一步推导该过程的熵产生，并分解为活化项、堆积项、扭转项与别构项。错配类型依赖性仅由每个错配类型的一个twist偏差和一对配对权重承载。
AI.result: 模型不使用任何外部热力学数据库，在两个独立的体内测定dCas9-sgRNA错配变体文库中分别取得Spearman相关0.84与0.82。模型重现了种子区敏感性、PAM近端活性梯度以及dDrG错配的中等代价，同时识别出高活性双错配尾部区域为当前自由能映射失效的情形。框架还可定量预测DNA超螺旋与序列上下文对结合亲和力的调制。
AI.conclusion: R-loop形成的动力学—热力学耦合建模可在无外部参数库条件下达到较高预测精度，并为sgRNA设计提供机制性依据；未来需改进自由能映射以覆盖高活性双错配区域。

title: FlakeForge: automated lithography-ready device layout from optical images of exfoliated van der Waals flakes
summary: Fabricating a device from an exfoliated van der Waals flake requires finding a suitable flake under a microscope and designing its lithography layout by hand. We present FlakeForge, an open-source pipeline from raw optical images of a marker-patterned chip to a lithography-ready, multilayer design file. It scores flakes for device usability, aligns and scales each image from its markers, fits the user's device design to each selected flake's contour and connects every contact to a bond pad by a trace routed around all earlier devices, so no two overlap. Demonstrated on Hall bars and Little-Parks rings, it processed four chips in about half an hour, work that took an expert days. It runs fully unattended or pauses for user review. Adapting it to a new material, marker design or device dimensions requires only configuration, with no training data; a new device type requires only its geometry definition.

AI.tldr: FlakeForge是一个开源流程，从标记芯片的原始光学图像自动生成可直接用于光刻的多层设计文件，涵盖薄片筛选评分、图像对齐缩放、器件轮廓拟合与自动走线布线。
AI.motivation: 从剥离的范德华薄片制备器件时，需在显微镜下人工寻找合适薄片并手工设计光刻版图，耗时且依赖专家经验。
AI.method: 1) 对薄片进行器件可用性评分；2) 基于标记点的图像对齐与尺度校准；3) 将用户器件设计拟合到所选薄片轮廓；4) 自动布线，使每个电极经走线连接至焊盘，并绕开先前器件以保证无重叠；5) 支持全自动运行或用户中途复核；新材料/标记/尺寸仅需配置，新器件类型仅需几何定义。
AI.result: 在霍尔条与Little-Parks环上验证，约半小时内处理四片芯片，而同类工作专家需数天。
AI.conclusion: FlakeForge提供了免训练数据、可配置、可扩展的自动化薄片器件版图设计流程，显著缩短从图像到光刻就绪文件的时间。

title: Quantum-Metric-Driven Hollow Wigner Crystals
summary: Recent studies have revealed the profound influence of Berry curvature on electron crystallization, yet the independent role of the quantum metric remains unclear. Here, we introduce a minimal three-band continuum model with separately tunable quantum metric and Berry flux. Employing the Hartree-Fock approach, we find that a conventional s-wave Wigner crystal can develop a hollow charge distribution with depleted density at lattice sites, without a change in symmetry or topology. We show that this density reconstruction occurs even at vanishing Berry curvature and arises from strong quantum metric and the nontrivial angular structure of the form factor. In our model, the continuous crossover between hollow and conventional WCs is accompanied by anomalous direct exchange interactions, nearly vanishing at intermediate quantum metric but enhanced by over an order of magnitude in the strong-metric regime. These results reveal how quantum metric can reshape both the charge distribution and exchange interactions of electron crystals beyond simple wave-function delocalization.

AI.tldr: 该文构建一个量子度规与Berry通量可独立调节的最小三带连续模型，用Hartree-Fock方法证明量子度规本身（无需Berry曲率）即可将常规s波Wigner晶体转变为位点密度耗尽的"空心"电荷分布，并伴随异常的直接交换相互作用增强。
AI.motivation: 已有研究揭示Berry曲率对电子结晶的深刻影响，但量子度规（quantum metric）在其中的独立作用尚不清楚，缺乏能将量子度规与Berry通量解耦研究的可控模型。
AI.method: 提出一个最小三带连续模型，使量子度规与Berry通量可分别独立调节；采用Hartree-Fock近似研究电子Wigner晶体的基态电荷分布与交换相互作用。
AI.result: 发现常规s波Wigner晶体可发展为"空心"电荷分布（晶格位点密度耗尽），且对称性与拓扑均不变；该密度重构在Berry曲率为零时也出现，源于强量子度规及形状因子的非平庸角向结构。空心态与常规态之间为连续渡越，伴随异常的direct exchange：在中等量子度规下趋近于零，在强度规区增强超过一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 量子度规不仅能通过波函数离域化，还能重塑电子晶体的电荷分布与交换相互作用，是独立于Berry曲率的关键调控自由度量。

title: Verification and Evaluation of A Comprehensive Quantum Simulation Compiler
summary: Hamiltonian simulation is a central application of quantum computing, yet most existing compilers offer no machine-checked guarantee that the circuits they produce approximate the intended evolution. The previous QBlue compiler verifies a Hamiltonian simulation compiler containing only Trotter-based algorithms. It takes a Hamiltonian written over Pauli strings, a simulation time, and an error bound, and produces a circuit or analog schedule that is proven, in the Rocq proof assistant, to approximate the ideal time evolution within that bound and proves a single end-to-end error bound that composes the errors of the individual stages; the compiler uses it to select, by resource estimation, the cheapest algorithm that meets the user's bound. This paper advances the verification efforts with two further steps. First, we extend QBlue to $\textsf{QBlue}_{\texttt{BE}}$ by verifying another important compilation method for Hamiltonian simulation: block-encoding-based (BE-based) algorithms. Second, we empirically evaluate 279 Hamiltonian simulation programs against the state-of-the-art BE-based compiler, PennyLane. For many programs, our compiler shows a $94\%$ gate reduction compared to PennyLane. Additionally, we also discover issues and bugs in PennyLane. We also compare Trotter- and BE-based algorithms, providing a practical comparison for the long-standing debate over which algorithms perform better. Our results surprisingly show that Trotter-based algorithms may gain a practical advantage, even though BE algorithms have a theoretical advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文将形式化验证的 QBlue 编译器扩展为 QBlue_BE，在 Rocq 中验证了基于块编码（BE）的哈密顿模拟编译算法，并在 279 个程序上实证对比 PennyLane，显示最高 94% 的量子门削减，同时发现 PennyLane 的问题；比较表明 Trotter 方法可能具有实际优势。
AI.motivation: 现有哈密顿模拟编译器多缺乏机器检验的正确性保证；此前 QBlue 仅覆盖 Trotter 类算法，缺乏对理论上更优的块编码类算法的验证与实证比较，且"BE 与 Trotter 孰优"的长期争论缺少实践证据。
AI.method: 在 Rocq 证明助手中扩展 QBlue，验证块编码类哈密顿模拟编译方法，形成 QBlue_BE，并保持端到端误差界与基于资源估计的最省算法选择机制；随后以 279 个哈密顿模拟程序为基准，与最先进的 PennyLane 对比，并比较 Trotter 与 BE 两类算法。
AI.result: 在许多程序上相较 PennyLane 实现 94% 的门数削减；发现 PennyLane 中的若干问题与缺陷。Trotter 类算法在实际中可能优于 BE 类算法，尽管理论上 BE 具有优势。
AI.conclusion: 形式化验证可扩展至 BE 类哈密顿模拟算法并保持端到端正确性保证；理论最优并不等于实践最优，算法选择应结合资源估计与实证评估。

title: Geometry-controlled clogging and transport mechanisms in confined Y-junctions
summary: We investigate transport and clogging of hard particles in a confined symmetric Y-junction using off-lattice Monte Carlo simulations. The geometry is controlled by the channel width w and a truncation parameter s that modifies the inner vertex. The flow probability exhibits a sharp sigmoidal crossover, defining a characteristic width wc that depends non-monotonically on s. This non-monotonic behavior persists under variations of the transverse Monte Carlo step, although the absolute values of wc change. Microscopic analysis reveals two distinct blocking mechanisms: single-particle obstruction at small truncations and collective arch-like structures at larger truncations. Residence-time statistics and particle-order inversions provide additional evidence of this change in transport dynamics. Our results demonstrate that local modifications of junction geometry can strongly affect clogging and particle transport, even in a minimal model with excluded-volume interactions only.

AI.tldr: 用离格蒙特卡洛模拟研究硬粒子在受限对称Y形结中的输运与堵塞，发现存在由特征宽度wc刻画急剧S形转变，且wc随内顶点截断参数s非单调变化，对应单粒子阻塞与集体拱形堵塞两种机制。
AI.motivation: 探究结几何的局部修饰（通道宽度、内顶点截断）如何影响受限通道中硬粒子的输运与堵塞行为。
AI.method: 离格蒙特卡洛模拟；以通道宽度w与修饰内顶点的截断参数s控制几何；统计流动概率、居留时间分布与粒子次序反转；改变横向蒙特卡洛步长检验稳健性。
AI.result: 流动概率呈陡峭S形转变并定义特征宽度wc；wc随s非单调变化，该非单调性在横向步长变化下仍保持（绝对值改变）；微观分析揭示小截断下为单粒子阻塞、大截断下为集体拱形结构堵塞；居留时间统计与粒子次序反转佐证输运动力学转变。
AI.conclusion: 即便在仅含排除体积相互作用的极简模型中，结几何的局部修饰也能强烈影响堵塞与粒子输运。

title: Kinetic inductance of two-dimensional viscous electron fluid
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, to be published in JETP Letters
summary: Modern high-mobility two-dimensional electron systems are pure enough to manifest hydrodynamic regime of electron transport similar to dynamics of classical fluids. With the bulk scattering controlled by momentum-conserving electron-electron collisions, these novel hydrodynamic materials demonstrate systematic violation of conventional metallic behavior due to the Drude model in stationary electric transport. In this letter, we study the linear reactive AC response of 2D electron fluid in a narrow channel geometry and show that the essentially non-local viscous dissipation induces non-trivial size effect in it. In particular, kinetic inductance, which represents collective inertia of the entire electron fluid, is enhanced by non-uniform flow profile and, in contrast to diffusive transport, dominates the electrical impedance already in collisional regime by virtue of viscous skin effect. The onset of reactive behavior falls within the microwave frequency domain in the state-of-the-art 2D hydrodynamic conductors which makes them promising material system for applications in high-frequency electronics at elevated temperatures.

AI.tldr: 研究了窄通道二维电子流体的线性交流响应，发现非局域黏性耗散导致尺寸效应，黏性趋肤效应使动能电感在碰撞区即主导阻抗，响应起点位于微波频段。
AI.motivation: 高迁移率二维电子系统已足够纯净，可进入电子输运的流体力学区，此时动量守恒的电子-电子碰撞主导弛豫，直流输运系统性偏离Drude模型；但对其交流/高频响应，尤其是黏性对反应性（电感性）响应的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在窄通道几何下求解二维电子流体的线性反应性交流响应，考虑非局域的黏性耗散与黏性趋肤效应，分析流速剖面非均匀性对动能电感与阻抗的贡献。
AI.result: 非局域黏性耗散诱导出显著的尺寸效应；代表整体电子流体集体惯性的动能电感因非均匀流速剖面而增强，并借助黏性趋肤效应在碰撞区即主导电阻抗，而不像扩散输运那样需更高频率。
AI.conclusion: 二维流体力学导体的反应性行为起点落在微波频段，使其成为高温高频电子学应用的有前景材料体系。

title: Ground-State Manifold Curvature and Phase Transitions in the Kitaev Honeycomb Model
summary: The Kitaev honeycomb model is an exactly solvable spin model whose ground state realizes a quantum spin liquid with gapped Abelian phases and a gapless phase that becomes a non-Abelian phase in a magnetic field. Here we study its phase transitions through the geometry of the ground-state manifold, using the Ricci scalar of the quantum metric. In the three gapped phases we obtain closed-form expressions for the curvature, which is negative and diverges at the critical lines; the three phases are related to one another by an exact change of coordinates. In the gapless phase, the curvature of the infrared-regularized metric is positive and decays inversely with the logarithm of the system size, with a size-independent amplitude that diverges at the phase boundaries, with an exponent different from that of the gapped side. The change of sign and the divergences together reproduce the complete phase diagram. A magnetic field gaps out the gapless phase and plays the role of the infrared cutoff, so that away from the critical lines the curvature of the non-Abelian phase becomes finite and positive, while around the critical lines it opens a crossover region whose width scales quadratically with the field. Since divergences of geometric quantities are often regarded as signatures of phase transitions, the divergence of the Ricci scalar at the critical lines provides a geometric signature of these transitions.

AI.tldr: 利用量子几何中Ricci标量研究Kitaev蜂窝模型的相变：有能隙相曲率为负且在临界线发散，无能隙相（红外正则化后）曲率为正并随1/ln L衰减，磁场下非阿贝尔相曲率有限为正，并给出与磁场平方成正比的渡越区宽度，从而完整重现相图。
AI.motivation: 几何量（如曲率）的发散常被视为相变标志，作者希望以基态流形的Ricci标量为工具，给出Kitaev蜂窝模型各相及其相变的统一几何刻画。
AI.method: 计算基态流形上量子度规的Ricci标量：对有能隙的三个相求闭式解；对无能隙相采用红外正则化度规；再引入磁场使无能隙相打开能隙，考察非阿贝尔相的曲率行为及临界线附近的渡越区宽度。
AI.result: 有能隙三相曲率为负，在临界线发散，且三相通过精确坐标变换相互联系；无能隙相（红外正则化）曲率为正，按系统尺寸对数倒数衰减，幅值与尺寸无关并在相边界发散，其指数与有能隙侧不同；曲率符号改变与发散共同重现完整相图；磁场充当红外截断，非阿贝尔相远离临界线时曲率有限且为正，临界线附近形成宽度随磁场二次标度的渡越区。
AI.conclusion: Ricci标量在临界线的发散为Kitaev蜂窝模型的相变提供了几何标志，曲率的符号变化与发散行为足以完整刻画其相图。

title: Froq: Safe Speculative Execution on Live Quantum States for FTQC
summary: Reducing execution time is critical to fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) as longer executions expose logical qubits to more opportunities for failure. However, quantum processors could frequently stall due to slow classical error-correction decoders. Recent speculative decoding accelerates this process, but its speculation remains on the classical side, leaving quantum operations waiting for confirmed decoding results. Extending speculative execution to the quantum side is fundamentally challenging. Unlike classical processor states, quantum states cannot be arbitrarily copied or checkpointed for rollback, making recovery from mispredictions difficult. In this work, we propose Froq to enable safe speculative execution on live quantum states. Froq uses compiler-assisted recovery contracts to track how mispredictions propagate through quantum operations. It further employs a resource-aware runtime mechanism to reserve recovery workspace and dynamically balance the benefits of speculative execution against the expected costs of recovery. We evaluate Froq on eight FTQC programs across 88 configurations, building on an existing speculative window decoder. Froq reduces quantum-side time by 9.81% across all 88 configurations. The reduction reaches 18.34% across the 45 configurations allowing concurrent predictions, and peaks at 31.1% at code distance d=21, under limited resources.

AI.tldr: Froq：面向容错量子计算的量子态级推测执行框架
AI.motivation: 容错量子计算中，执行时间越长逻辑量子比特暴露于失效的机会越多，因此缩短执行时间至关重要。但经典纠错解码器速度慢，会导致量子处理器频繁停顿。现有推测解码仅在经典侧加速，量子操作仍需等待已确认的解码结果。
AI.method: 提出 Froq，将推测执行扩展到量子侧。核心难点是量子态不可任意复制或检查点回滚，误预测难以恢复。Froq 采用编译器辅助的恢复契约（recovery contracts）追踪误预测在量子操作间的传播；并设计资源感知的运行时机制，预留恢复工作空间，动态权衡推测执行的收益与恢复的预期代价。
AI.result: 在 8 个 FTQC 程序、88 种配置上基于现有 speculative window decoder 进行评估，Froq 在全部 88 种配置下将量子侧时间降低 9.81%；在允许并发预测的 45 种配置下降低 18.34%；在码距 d=21 且资源受限时峰值降幅达 31.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将推测执行延伸至量子侧可有效缓解解码延迟导致的停顿，在安全可恢复的前提下获得显著时间收益，且收益随码距增大而提升。

title: Multipartite entanglement structure of crystal quenches
summary: Understanding how entanglement emerges and spreads in out-of-equilibrium quantum many-body systems is a fundamental problem. In this paper, we investigate multipartite entanglement after quantum quenches. In particular, we study the entanglement structure and dynamics of quasiparticle multiplets generated by crystal quenches in the tight-binding chain. We identify zero-configurations for which a multiplet shared between three parties has no irreducible tripartite entanglement---these configurations consist entirely of pairwise distributed bipartite-entangled states. The existence of zero-configurations has important implications on the entanglement structure and dynamics of crystal quenches. For example, we show that it can further delay the production of tripartite entanglement. We build the quasiparticle picture for the Markov gap, and prove that it is a faithful witness of irreducible tripartite entanglement for crystal quenches. We discuss several key aspects of their tripartite entanglement dynamics through the lens of the Markov gap. We confront our results with exact lattice numerics and find perfect agreement in the hydrodynamic regime.

AI.tldr: 本文研究紧束缚链中晶体淬火产生的准粒子多重态的纠缠结构与动力学，识别出使三体间多重态无不可约三体纠缠的"零构型"，构建Markov gap的准粒子图像并证明其可忠实见证不可约三体纠缠，数值验证在水动力学区完全吻合。
AI.motivation: 理解非平衡量子多体系统中纠缠如何产生与传播是基本问题，而多分体纠缠（尤其不可约三体纠缠）在淬火后的结构演化尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以紧束缚链中的晶体淬火为对象，分析其产生的准粒子多重态；定义并研究零构型（多重态在三方间仅呈两两二分纠缠、无不可约三体纠缠）；构建Markov gap的准粒子图像，并将其作为不可约三体纠缠的见证量；与精确格点数值结果对比。
AI.result: 存在由纯两两二分纠缠构成、无不可约三体纠缠的零构型；零构型可进一步延迟三体纠缠的产生；证明Markov gap对晶体淬火是不可约三体纠缠的忠实见证；准粒子图像给出的三体纠缠动力学在水动力学区与精确格点数值完全一致。
AI.conclusion: 准粒子多重态图像可定量刻画淬火后三方纠缠的结构与动力学，Markov gap是实用的三体纠缠见证量，零构型的识别为调控纠缠生成时标提供了机制。

title: Sondheimer oscillations in Weyl semimetal films
summary: In conducting films subject to an out-of-plane magnetic field, electron motion between the surfaces gives rise to conductance oscillations periodic in magnetic field, known as Sondheimer oscillations. While this size effect has been investigated in conventional metals, its dependence on the Berry curvature of topological materials remains less explored. In this work, we extend the semiclassical Boltzmann description of Sondheimer oscillations to type-I Weyl semimetal films. We account for the Berry curvature, the orbital magnetic moment and the effect of the Zeeman coupling on the Fermi wavevector and the electronic group velocity. The Berry curvature and the orbital magnetic moment generate a beating pattern and chirping in the Sondheimer oscillations. In the thick-film and thin-film regimes, we provide analytical expressions for the longitudinal conductivity, which highlight the interplay between electronic band topology and boundary-scattering in magnetotransport.

AI.tldr: 本文将Sondheimer振荡的半经典Boltzmann描述推广到I型Weyl半金属薄膜，纳入Berry曲率、轨道磁矩与Zeeman耦合对费米波矢和群速度的影响，发现Berry曲率与轨道磁矩导致Sondheimer振荡出现拍频与chirping，并给出厚膜、薄膜极限下纵向电导率的解析表达式。
AI.motivation: Sondheimer振荡（垂直磁场下表面间电子运动引起的、以磁场为周期的电导振荡）此前主要在传统金属中研究，其对拓扑材料Berry曲率的依赖尚不清楚，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在半经典Boltzmann输运框架下，对I型Weyl半金属薄膜建立Sondheimer振荡理论；显式引入Berry曲率、轨道磁矩以及Zeeman耦合对费米波矢与电子群速度的修正，并分别在厚膜与薄膜区做解析近似。
AI.result: Berry曲率与轨道磁矩使Sondheimer振荡产生拍频（beating pattern）与频率啁啾（chirping）；在厚膜与薄膜两种极限下得到纵向电导率的解析表达式。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了电子能带拓扑与边界散射在磁输运中的相互作用，表明Sondheimer振荡可作为探测拓扑能带（Berry曲率、轨道磁矩）的输运手段。

title: Exact many-body scars of generic spin models from singlet covers
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures; Supplemental Material: 7 pages, 1 figure
summary: The square-lattice transverse-field Ising model has exact zero-energy eigenstates at any field: products of singlets on alternate plaquette diagonals. A longitudinal field isolates them from a symmetry-protected degeneracy. The mechanism is that a site coupled equally to both ends of a singlet annihilates it. The result thus holds for any spin $s$, anisotropic exchange, a large class of bond disorder and certain three-spin terms. This mechanism decides which lattices host such states: two of the 11 Archimedean lattices (four at $s=1/2$), bcc and quasicrystals with spins on the edges. Singlet pumping cools any state into them.

AI.tldr: 方格子横场Ising模型在任意场下存在精确零能本征态——交替方格对角线上的单态乘积；纵场解除对称保护简并使其可被孤立。
AI.motivation: 横场Ising模型通常被认为不存在可严格求解的零能态，作者希望寻找在任意场强下仍精确成立的量子多体本征态，并厘清其存在的普适机制与格点判据。
AI.method: 构造交替格面对角线上的单态直积态；核心机制为“与单态两端等强耦合的格点将其湮灭”。据此推广到任意自旋s、各向异性交换、大范围键无序及若干三自旋项；并用该机制逐一判定11种阿基米德格点、bcc及边自旋准晶是否承载此类态。
AI.result: 方格子（任意场）精确零能；s=1/2时11种阿基米德格点中有4种、一般自旋下仅2种支持该态；bcc格点与边自旋准晶亦支持。单态泵浦可将任意态冷却至这些态。
AI.conclusion: 零能本征态源于单态湮灭机制而非特殊参数微调，故具有强鲁棒性；该机制给出格点承载性的分类判据，并提供可实现的冷却/态制备途径。

title: Causal Consistency and Cost of Quantum Control
summary: An unknown quantum state can supply the information needed to control a computation, but how much quantum data must be consumed to perform a prescribed action? We connect this resource question to causal consistency within the quantum state space. No-signaling requires identical observable predictions for remotely chosen ensemble preparations of the same complete input; quantum distinguishability then converts this requirement into finite-copy bounds. For amplitude amplification, we identify an exact low-copy obstruction and establish a dimension-independent, optimal quadratic dependence of the copy cost on angular gain at fixed accuracy, uniformly over arbitrary pure inputs. A coherent protocol attains this scaling without reconstructing a classical state description. Prior knowledge of a real two-level family additionally permits exponentially decreasing error with the copy budget at fixed gain. These results separate the resources needed to perform a specified quantum operation from those needed for universal state reconstruction. The central connection is operational: physical consistency restricts which distinctions a controller can expose, and the information carried by its complete input determines the cost of doing so. This links a causal requirement to quantitative limits on converting quantum data into computational control.

AI.tldr: 本文把"控制未知量子态所需消耗的量子数据量"与量子态空间中的因果一致性（无信号性）联系起来，证明振幅放大在固定精度下拷贝代价对角度增益呈维度无关的最优二次依赖，并给出一类先验知识下误差可随拷贝数指数下降的情形，从而区分"执行指定量子操作"与"普适态重构"两种资源需求。
AI.motivation: 未知量子态可作为控制计算的信息来源，但为执行一个指定操作究竟需消耗多少量子数据，此前缺乏定量刻画。作者希望把这一资源问题与更基本的物理约束（因果性/无信号性）建立联系，而非仅从态估计或层析的角度讨论。
AI.method: 以无信号性为出发点：对同一完整输入的不同远程集合制备，必须给出相同的可观测预测；借助量子可区分性，将该要求转化为有限拷贝数约束。在此基础上针对振幅放大构造精确的低拷贝障碍（下界），并设计不重构经典态描述（不做层析）的相干协议以匹配该标度，同时在具有实数二维族先验知识时分析误差随拷贝预算的衰减。
AI.result: 对振幅放大得到精确的低拷贝阻碍；证明拷贝代价对角度增益在固定精度下具有维度无关的最优二次依赖，且对任意纯输入一致成立；相干协议无需经典重构即可达到该标度；若已知输入属于实数二维族，则在固定增益下误差可随拷贝预算指数下降。
AI.conclusion: 结果将"执行特定量子操作"与"普适态重构"的资源需求分离：物理一致性限制了控制器可暴露的区分，而其完整输入所携带的信息决定实现控制的代价。这一联系把因果性要求转化为"量子数据→计算控制"转化的定量极限。

title: Statistical mechanics of noisy collisions in active matter: Dyson-Landau theory
summary: Active systems and other coarse-grained descriptions are often modeled by generalized dynamics, effective equations of motion that are not bound by the constraints of genuinely microscopic physics. In particular, these equations are generally stochastic on the smallest resolved scale. This poses a challenge to first-principles statistical physics, which usually derives emergent noise on larger scales from deterministic interactions. Here, we show how to systematically incorporate microscopic noise into kinetic theory in the limit of weak noise, i.e., high activity. By means of a Dyson expansion of the noisy free propagator, we derive the leading correction to the Landau kinetic equation for weakly interacting systems. We find that the common practice of combining a deterministic collision integral with the diffusive terms of the Fokker--Planck equation is the correct leading order. For dry aligning active matter, however, the corrections are non-analytic in the noise strength, as nearly parallel particles interact for arbitrarily long times. For noise that acts only during interactions, a minimal model of stochastic interactions, noise and collisions do not decouple: the leading corrections are odd in the coupling strength, partly logarithmically enhanced, and amount to an orientation-dependent effective noise strength. Agent-based simulations confirm the predicted dependence on the sign of the coupling. Even in this minimal model, the effect of noise on collisions can thus not be inferred from symmetry alone.

AI.tldr: 本文将弱噪声下的微观噪声系统地纳入动理学理论，用噪声自由传播子的Dyson展开导出弱相互作用系统Landau动理方程的领头修正，并揭示干性排列活性物质中修正对噪声强度的非解析依赖。
AI.motivation: 活性系统与粗粒化描述常用广义动力学（有效运动方程），这些方程在最小分辨尺度上通常是随机的，不受真正微观物理约束。这与第一性原理统计物理通常"从确定性相互作用导出大尺度涌现噪声"的做法相冲突，因此需要回答：微观噪声如何系统地进入动理学理论，以及常见的"确定性碰撞积分+Fokker–Planck扩散项"拼合做法是否正确。
AI.method: 在弱噪声（高活性）极限下，对带有噪声的自由传播子做Dyson展开，将其系统纳入动理学理论；对弱相互作用系统推导Landau动理方程的领头阶修正；进一步分析干性排列活性物质（近于平行的粒子长时间相互作用）情形；并构建"噪声仅在相互作用期间起作用"的随机相互作用最小模型，与基于个体的（agent-based）模拟结果对照检验。
AI.result: 1）对弱相互作用系统，常见做法——确定性碰撞积分叠加Fokker–Planck扩散项——恰是正确的最低阶近似。2）对干性排列活性物质，修正对噪声强度是非解析的，因为近乎平行的粒子相互作用时间可任意长。3）在"噪声仅作用于相互作用期间"的最小模型中，噪声与碰撞不脱耦：领头修正对耦合强度为奇次依赖，部分含对数增强，等价于方向依赖的有效噪声强度；基于个体的模拟证实了其对耦合强度符号的预测依赖。
AI.conclusion: 微观噪声可借助Dyson展开系统地进入动理学理论。常用拼合近似在弱相互作用下成立，但在干性排列活性物质等长时相互作用情形下失效；即便在最小模型中，噪声对碰撞的影响也不能仅由对称性推断，须显式计算。

title: Geometric Polarization-Virial Theorems for Field-Induced Dipolar Interactions and Force Reversal
summary: Electric fields can turn attraction into repulsion between far-separated atoms, yet the complete angular mechanical structure governing this reversal has remained unknown. Here, we uncover an entropy-like geometric structure: the cubically weighted interaction free energy, r^3 F(r), is nondecreasing under physical dilation. This structure unifies two exact polarization-virial theorems for arbitrary stable quasistatic dipole assemblies and fully retarded dipole pairs under stated conditions. Consequently, the free energy has at most one zero and energetic cancellation precedes mechanical cancellation. A force zero retains strictly positive energy, whereas an energy zero retains an attractive force. The resulting analytical angular fine structure is resolved by a quantum harmonic oscillator pair, yielding the complete arbitrary-angle interaction energy and radial force that recover quantum-perturbative results. The conventional dipolar magic angle splits into strictly ordered energy- and force-zero angles; the latter uniquely bounds the radially repulsive sector and carries a positive energy barrier. Derived scaling laws and finite-sphere calculations provide experimentally testable signatures from microscopic dipoles to macroscopic polarizable bodies.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一种熵式几何结构：立方加权的相互作用自由能 r³F(r) 在物理伸缩下单调不减。该结构统一了两个精确的极化位力定理，并给出角向"精细结构"的完整解析刻画。
AI.motivation: 远距原子间电场可使吸引转为排斥，但支配这一反转的完整角度力学结构此前未知，需要给出能量零点与力零点之间的严格关系。
AI.method: 构造熵式几何结构（自由度 r³F(r) 在伸缩下非减），证明适用于任意稳定准静态偶极集合及满足条件的完全延迟偶极对的两个精确极化-位力定理；用量子谐振子对解析求解角向精细结构，并做有限球体数值计算。
AI.result: 自由能至多一个零点，且能量抵消先于力学抵消：力零点处能量严格为正，能量零点处力仍为吸引。得到完整任意角度相互作用能与径向力，回归量子微扰结果；传统偶极魔法角分裂为严格有序的能量零点角与力零点角，后者唯一边界径向排斥区并带正能量势垒；给出可检验的标度律。
AI.conclusion: 偶极相互作用的角向结构由单调性定理所约束，能量与力学反转存在普适次序，为从微观偶极到宏观极化体的实验检验提供预言。

title: Projecting Fermions into Exact Scar Towers: Local Protection across Phase Transitions
summary: We construct exact scar towers in $SO(n)$ ($n\ge3$) spin chains by Gutzwiller projection of $n$-flavor flat-band Kitaev chains. The projected roots have only singlet and antisymmetric components on each bond. These local constraints allow a staggered flavor flip to generate an equidistant tower. The root and its first descendant exhaust the two-site configurations that are visited by the tower, leaving an orthogonal bond subspace unvisited. Deformations within this subspace can break $SO(n)$ symmetry and reshape the low-energy physics without altering the exact scar tower. A polarization-selective deformation drives an exact first-order transition from the symmetry-protected topological phase to a ferromagnetic phase. The tower retains its wave functions and absolute energies across the phase transition, including at the gapless point. Exact scars therefore need not inherit the symmetries, order parameters, or criticality of the ground state.

AI.tldr: 通过Gutzwiller投影n味平带Kitaev链构造SO(n)(n≥3)自旋链中的精确scar塔，并证明其可与基态对称性、序参量和临界性解耦。
AI.motivation: 探索量子多体scar（本征态热化破缺）在连续对称性SO(n)体系中的构造与稳定性，尤其是scar态是否必须继承基态的低能物理特征。
AI.method: 将n味平带Kitaev链做Gutzwiller投影，得到SO(n)自旋链；投影后的根态在每个键上只含单态与反对称分量，借此局域约束用交错味翻转生成等间距scar塔；再在该塔未访问的正交键子空间内引入形变。
AI.result: 根态及其第一后代穷尽了塔所访问的二格点构型，留下未被访问的正交键子空间；该子空间内的形变可破坏SO(n)对称性并重塑低能物理，而scar塔（波函数与绝对能量）保持不变；一种极化选择性形变可驱动从对称保护拓扑相到铁磁相的精确一阶相变，塔在包括无能点在内的相变处保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 精确scar无需继承基态的对称性、序参量或临界性，因而可与体系的低能物理高度解耦。

title: Coherent Control of Single-Photon Emission in Broadband Plasmonic Resonators
summary: Encoding phase information with quantum emitters in metallic optical nanocavities is challenging due to ultrafast relaxation induced by the broadband nature of the plasmonic near field. Using macroscopic quantum electrodynamics theory, we demonstrate that an individual emitter strongly coupled to a plasmonic nanocavity field that is driven by a pulsed laser with frequency comb spectrum undergoes spontaneous emission of well-resolved one-photon pulses whose amplitude scales quadratically with the number of frequency comb components due to coherent accumulation, and ultrashort non-exponential temporal profiles with duration set by the light-matter coupling strength. Conditions are discussed for exponentially suppressing the probability of two or more emission events within the lifetime of the coupled emitter-nanocavity system. The spectral signatures of the optimal one-photon wavepackets are discussed. This work paves the way for the development of ultrafast laser-triggered single-photon emitters using atoms and molecules in optical nanocavities.

AI.tldr: 利用宏观量子电动力学理论，证明在频率梳脉冲驱动的等离激元纳米腔中，强耦合的单个发射体可通过相干累积发射波形由耦合强度决定的超短单光子波包，并给出抑制多光子发射的条件。
AI.motivation: 金属光学纳米腔中，等离激元近场的宽带特性会导致超快弛豫，使在该体系中编码相位信息十分困难。作者希望探索在此不利条件下仍能实现可控单光子发射的途径。
AI.method: 采用宏观量子电动力学（macroscopic QED）理论，考察单个发射体与等离激元纳米腔场强耦合、且腔场由具有频率梳光谱的脉冲激光驱动的情形，解析计算其自发辐射的单光子波包性质。
AI.result: （1）发射体自发辐射出分辨良好的单光子脉冲，其振幅因相干累积而随频率梳分量数目呈二次方增长；（2）发射的时间波形为非指数型的超短轮廓，持续时间由光-物质耦合强度设定；（3）讨论了在耦合发射体-纳米腔系统寿命内指数式压制两次及以上发射事件概率的条件；（4）分析了最优单光子波包的光谱特征。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为利用原子和分子在光学纳米腔中发展超快激光触发的单光子发射器奠定了基础。

title: Donnan Grand Canonical Monte Carlo Simulations with Fast Ewald Summation for Calculating Individual Ionic Chemical Potentials
summary: We present a Donnan Grand Canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) simulation method using fast Ewald summation to accurately and efficiently calculate the individual ionic excess chemical potentials of $α_+:α_-$ electrolyte solutions. By introducing a dynamic inner electrostatic potential that acts to penalize net charge fluctuations and maintain average charge neutrality ($\langle Q_t \rangle = 0$), the method enables single-ion GCMC trial moves without sacrificing convergence speed or breaking thermodynamic consistency. Unlike the Widom particle insertion method---which suffers from severe phase-space sampling bottlenecks and requires separate virtual insertions for each ionic species---the Donnan GCMC protocol simultaneously yields the individual excess chemical potentials $μ_+^{\text{ex}}$ and $μ_-^{\text{ex}}$ corresponding to a resulting bulk concentration $c_b$ with rapid numerical convergence. Varying the reference activity parameter $c_r$ allows us to efficiently construct the complete $μ_\pm^{\text{ex}}(c_b)$ curves. Comparison with the Mean Spherical Approximation (MSA) demonstrates excellent agreement for size-symmetric electrolytes, while highlighting the failure of linear-response theories for size-asymmetric ions where electrostatic correlations and cavity effects become strongly coupled.

AI.tldr: 提出基于快速Ewald求和的Donnan巨正则蒙特卡洛(GCMC)方法，通过引入动态内电势惩罚净电荷涨落、维持平均电中性，实现单离子插入/删除，可同时快速得到电解质中单个离子的超额化学势 μ+ex、μ-ex 及其随浓度变化的全曲线。
AI.motivation: Widom粒子插入法在计算单个离子超额化学势时存在严重的相空间采样瓶颈，且对每种离子需分别做虚拟插入；线性响应类理论（如MSA）在离子尺寸不对称时的适用性也需要检验。
AI.method: 构建Donnan GCMC模拟：采用快速Ewald求和处理长程静电，引入动态内静电势以惩罚净电荷涨落并保持平均电中性(⟨Qt⟩=0)，从而允许单离子GCMC试探移动；通过调节参考活度参数 c_r 构造完整的 μ±ex(c_b) 曲线，并与平均球近似(MSA)结果对比。
AI.result: 该方法在不牺牲收敛速度、不破坏热力学一致性的前提下同时给出对应于体相浓度 c_b 的 μ+ex 与 μ-ex，数值收敛快；与MSA在尺寸对称电解质中吻合良好，而在尺寸不对称体系中线性响应理论失效，因静电关联与空腔效应强烈耦合。
AI.conclusion: Donnan GCMC是一种准确、高效计算电解质单离子超额化学势的方案，优于Widom插入法；同时揭示线性响应理论仅适用于尺寸对称离子，尺寸不对称体系需考虑静电关联与空腔效应的耦合。

title: Domain advantage in two-dimensional quantum-device design with multi-modal agentic harness
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, including End Matter; Supplemental Material: 5 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/caidish/KlayoutClaw
summary: High-quality two-dimensional quantum devices are commonly fabricated from mechanically exfoliated crystals, whose irregular shapes and placement require a lithographic layout tailored to each specimen. Drawing these layouts remains largely manual. We introduce qlaybench, a benchmark that tests whether language-model agents can turn microscope images and experimental requirements into device layouts that fit the specimen. Agents with conventional tools often construct devices when material outlines are supplied, but struggle to identify those outlines from images. Modelled on the human workflow, qlaybot, a multimodal agentic harness, connects image interpretation to the tools used to align images, draw device features and inspect the resulting layout. We evaluate each layout with checks drawn from practical design experience, asking whether it fits the specimen and connects its intended components. With greater computational effort, an agent using qlaybot passes 81.5% of the benchmark tasks, compared with 24.1% when it uses conventional tools. This domain advantage highlights the importance of connecting scientific interpretation of a specimen to geometric design and provides a route towards reducing manual effort in two-dimensional quantum-device fabrication.

AI.tldr: 提出qlaybench基准与qlaybot多模态智能体框架，使语言模型智能体能够将显微镜图像与实验需求转化为适配样品的二维量子器件版图，通过率从24.1%提升至81.5%。
AI.motivation: 机械剥离晶体制备的二维量子器件形状与位置不规则，需为每个样品定制光刻版图，而绘制工作基本依赖人工，效率低。现有智能体在给定材料轮廓时能构建器件，却难以直接从图像中识别轮廓。
AI.method: 构建qlaybench基准，以显微镜图像和实验要求为输入，检验智能体能否生成贴合样品的器件版图；并设计仿人类工作流的多模态智能体框架qlaybot，将图像理解与图像对齐、器件特征绘制、版图检查等工具相连接；采用源自实际设计经验的检查项评估版图是否适配样品并连接目标组件。
AI.result: 在更高计算投入下，使用qlaybot的智能体通过81.5%的基准任务，使用常规工具的智能体仅通过24.1%。
AI.conclusion: 该领域优势表明，将样品的科学解读与几何设计相连接至关重要，并为减少二维量子器件制备中的人工投入提供了路径。

title: Critical Topology: A New Perspective for Phase Transitions
comment: Invited perspective in Chinese Physics Letters. Any comments and suggestions are welcome !
summary:
Critical topology has emerged as a form of quantum criticality beyond the Landau paradigm, challenging conventional approaches to classifying universality classes by introducing topological properties as an additional criterion. Despite substantial progress over the past five years, several fundamental questions remain open. Theoretically, can we establish a general criterion for the emergence of critical topology? Can a unified theoretical framework be extended beyond one-dimensional quantum many-body systems? What efficient numerical methods can be developed to investigate critical topological states in higher-dimensional strongly correlated systems? Experimentally, research has so far focused primarily on single-particle critical topology. An important next step is to realize and characterize many-body critical topology in quantum systems using platforms such as Rydberg atom arrays, superconducting quantum processors, and quantum materials.
  Major advances in statistical physics often arise from re-examining fundamental concepts. The theory of critical phenomena developed by Landau, Ginzburg, and Wilson, together with the topological phase transitions pioneered by Kosterlitz and Thouless, has now inspired new discoveries in artificial acoustic metamaterials. These experimental observations mark a beginning rather than an endpoint for research on critical topology, and further advances in this direction are anticipated.

AI.tldr: 该文评述"临界拓扑"这一超越Landau范式的量子临界性新形式，梳理其理论判据、统一框架、高维强关联数值方法等开放问题，并指出实验上应从单粒子临界拓扑走向多体临界拓扑的实现与表征。
AI.motivation: 传统Landau范式以对称性破缺划分普适类，难以涵盖以拓扑性质为额外判据的临界现象；近五年进展虽多，但临界拓扑的普遍判据、超越一维的统一理论框架、高维强关联体系的高效数值方法，以及多体临界拓扑的实验实现均属未解问题。
AI.method: 采用综述与展望式论述：以Landau–Ginzburg–Wilson临界现象理论与Kosterlitz–Thouless拓扑相变作为思想源流，结合人工声学超材料中的实验观测，归纳该领域的理论瓶颈与实验路线（Rydberg原子阵列、超导量子处理器、量子材料）。
AI.result: 现有实验证据主要集中于单粒子临界拓扑，已在人工声学超材料等平台获得观测；理论方面尚缺乏普适判据与可推广至一维以上量子多体体系的统一框架，高维强关联临界拓扑态的高效数值方法亦有待发展。
AI.conclusion: 这些实验观测是临界拓扑研究的起点而非终点；未来需在理论上建立普适判据与统一框架、发展高维强关联数值方法，在实验上借助Rydberg原子阵列、超导量子处理器与量子材料实现并表征多体临界拓扑。

title: photon number correlations in harmonics driven with classical and quantum light
comment: 13 pages (8 main, 5 supplemental), 8 figures (5 main, 3 supplemental), Submitted to Optics Express
summary: Recent reports of nonclassical intensity correlations in harmonic generation raised questions about whether strong harmonic correlations necessarily imply genuinely quantum behaviour. Here, we compare the low-photon-number perturbative harmonic generation driven by classical and bright squeezed vacuum sources. The latter generates strong auto- and cross-correlations in the harmonic spectrum. Cauchy-Schwarz inequality and heralding measurements show that the cross-correlations are fully classical and can be explained by the common fluctuations from the driving field. A visible scaling of the measured correlation function with mean harmonic flux is observed, which is well-explained by a click detector-response model.

AI.tldr: 该文比较了经典光源与明亮压缩真空驱动下的低光子数谐波产生，证明谐波中观测到的强关联（包括交叉关联）可由驱动场共同涨落与探测器响应完全解释，属经典关联。
AI.motivation: 近期关于谐波产生中非经典强度关联的报道引发疑问：强谐波关联是否必然意味着真正的量子行为。作者希望厘清这一判据的有效性。
AI.method: 在低光子数微扰区比较经典光源与明亮压缩真空（BSV）驱动的谐波产生；测量谐波谱中的自相关与交叉关联，运用Cauchy–Schwarz不等式与预报（heralding）测量进行非经典性判定，并建立点击型探测器响应模型解释关联函数随平均谐波通量的可见标度关系。
AI.result: BSV驱动可在谐波谱中产生强自相关与交叉关联；但Cauchy–Schwarz不等式与预报测量表明这些交叉关联完全是经典的，可由驱动场的共同涨落解释；关联函数随平均谐波通量的标度关系可由点击探测器响应模型很好地描述。
AI.conclusion: 强谐波强度关联并不等于非经典性；非经典性判定需借助Cauchy–Schwarz不等式、预报测量等手段，并考虑探测器响应效应，否则易将经典关联误判为量子关联。

title: Fast-erasure energy-cost lower bound and its first-order correction under restricted control
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Yihang Cai and Yirong Jiang contributed equally to this work. Dahai He is the corresponding author
summary: Determining the minimum work required for information erasure is central to understanding the energetic limits of fast and reliable information processing. In the fast-erasure limit, we derive an explicit expression for this minimum work in a one-dimensional overdamped isothermal system with control restricted to linear and quadratic additions to a reference potential. For symmetric initial distributions at fixed mobility, the minimum work scales inversely with the erasure duration, with a prefactor determined solely by the second moment and a quantile associated with the target success probability. We further derive the leading finite-time correction at a prescribed success probability and verify both analytical predictions numerically. These results provide an analytical benchmark for fast erasure under restricted control, connecting a universal leading cost with finite-time corrections that account for the detailed form of the memory potential.

AI.tldr: 在受限于参考势的线性与二次控制项的一维过阻尼等温系统中，推导了快速擦除信息所需最小功的显式表达式：对称初态下最小功与擦除时长成反比，前因子仅由二阶矩与目标成功率对应的分位数决定，并给出有限时间修正。
AI.motivation: 确定信息擦除的最小功是理解快速、可靠信息处理能量极限的核心问题；已有结论多针对理想无约束控制或慢速极限，缺少在受限控制条件下快速擦除的解析基准。
AI.method: 在一维过阻尼等温随机动力学框架下，将控制限制为对参考势的线性与二次附加项，针对固定迁移率下的对称初始分布，求解快速擦除极限下的最小功，并解析推导给定时成功率下的有限时间领头修正，随后用数值方法验证两项解析预测。
AI.result: 最小功在快速极限下随擦除时长倒数标度，前因子仅由初始分布二阶矩与对应目标成功率的分位数决定；所得有限时间修正式依赖记忆势的具体形式；解析预测与数值结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了受限控制下快速信息擦除的解析基准，将普适的领头能量代价与反映记忆势细节的有限时间修正联系起来。

title: A Unified Energy-Density Framework for Moiré Interface Energetics and Mechanics
summary: The mechanical response of moiré interfaces depends on how atomic registry combines with contact size and boundary geometry. An analytical description must retain this discrete lattice information while connecting microscopic interactions to the energetics of finite contacts. Here, we develop a unified energy-density framework for rigid van der Waals interfaces by expressing registry-dependent pair potentials and atomic densities in reciprocal space. The resulting formulation accommodates different lattice bases and atomic species, linking single-atom and molecular adsorption to infinite bilayers and finite crystalline contacts. Explicit expressions for circular and regular polygonal flakes separate the area contribution from boundary-dependent terms and connect microscopic corrugation coefficients to energy barriers, rotational torques, and interlayer shear stiffnesses. The boundary analysis recovers the quarter-power area scaling of the barrier envelope for circular flakes and distinguishes bounded oscillations from square-root area scaling for polygonal contacts according to edge orientation. A dimensionless criterion characterizes the polygon-to-circle crossover in terms of moiré wavelength, flake size, and side number. Direct-summation benchmarks support the finite-domain expressions, while calculations for two-dimensional ice on graphene demonstrate the corresponding boundary-scaling trends in a molecular lattice. Applications to interlayer shear and graphite compression connect the same microscopic interaction description to tangential and normal mechanical responses. The framework establishes an analytical connection between microscopic registry, moiré periodicity, and finite-domain geometry, providing a basis for understanding and tailoring the energetics and mechanics of van der Waals contacts.

AI.tldr: 该文建立倒空间统一的能量密度框架，解析描述刚性范德华界面中原子配准、接触尺寸与边界几何的耦合，给出圆形与正多边形薄片的显式能量表达式及边界标度规律。
AI.motivation: 莫尔界面的力学响应取决于原子配准如何与接触尺寸、边界几何相结合，现有描述需在保留离散晶格信息的同时，把微观相互作用与有限接触的能量学联系起来。
AI.method: 将配准依赖的对势与原子密度在倒空间中展开，构建统一能量密度表述；该表述可兼容不同晶格基与原子种类，贯通单原子/分子吸附、无限双层与有限晶态接触；对圆形与正多边形薄片给出显式表达式，分离面积项与边界依赖项，并把微观起伏系数与能垒、转动力矩、层间剪切刚度相联系。
AI.result: 边界分析复现了圆形薄片能垒包络的四分之一幂面积标度；多边形接触依边取向呈现有界振荡或平方根面积标度；给出以莫尔波长、薄片尺寸和边数表示的多边形—圆形转变判据；直接求和基准验证有限域表达式，石墨烯上二维冰计算展示了分子晶格中的相应边界标度趋势。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在微观配准、莫尔周期性与有限域几何之间建立解析联系，并为理解与调控范德华接触的能量学与力学提供基础；层间剪切与石墨压缩应用将同一微观相互作用描述与切向、法向力学响应相联结。

title: Gyroidal Magnetic Order with Weyl Magnons
summary: The gyroid, a triply periodic minimal surface found widely in nature and materials, has remained largely unexplored as a design principle for magnetic order. We introduce gyroidal magnetic order on the hyperoctagon lattice, the skeletal network of the gyroid, in which each magnetic moment points along the local $C_3$ axis that coincides with the local normal to the gyroid surface. The resulting noncoplanar spin texture constitutes a direct magnetic imprint of the gyroid geometry. We show that this order can be stabilized by single-ion anisotropy, the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, or the symmetric off-diagonal $Γ$ interaction combined with the Kitaev interaction, and remains robust against quantum fluctuations. Its magnon spectrum hosts symmetry-enforced pseudospin-1 and pseudospin-1/2 Weyl points that, unlike their electronic counterparts, persist under symmetry-allowed perturbations. Our results establish the gyroid as a geometric platform for magnetic order and symmetry-enforced topological magnon excitations.

AI.tldr: 在hyperoctagon晶格上提出"螺旋状(gyroidal)磁序"，磁矩沿与gyroid曲面法向重合的局域C₃轴排列，形成非共面自旋织构；该序可由单离子各向异性、DM相互作用或Γ+Kitaev相互作用稳定，并对量子涨落鲁棒，其磁振子谱含受对称性保护的赝自旋1与1/2外尔点。
AI.motivation: gyroid（三周期极小曲面）在自然界与材料中广泛存在，但作为磁序设计原则几乎未被探索；作者希望把这种几何结构直接"印刻"到磁序上，并借此获得拓扑磁激发。
AI.method: 以gyroid的骨架网络——hyperoctagon晶格——为载体，令每个磁矩沿局域C₃轴（即gyroid曲面局域法向）取向，构造非共面自旋织构；通过分析单离子各向异性、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用以及对称非对角Γ项与Kitaev项组合的稳定机制，并计算磁振子谱与量子涨落效应。
AI.result: 该磁序可被上述三类相互作用分别稳定，且在量子涨落下保持稳健；磁振子谱中出现对称性强制的赝自旋1与赝自旋1/2外尔点，与电子体系不同，这些节点在对称性允许的微扰下依然存在。
AI.conclusion: gyroid可作为磁序的几何平台，并给出受对称性保护的拓扑磁振子激发，为几何—磁性—拓扑的交叉设计提供新途径。

title: Subquantum Pilot-Wave System Theory: Structural and Amplitude Nonequilibrium under Source Fields
summary: A source in the Schrodinger equation changes the norm of the guiding wave, apparently conflicting with the conservation of probability. In source-extended de Broglie-Bohm dynamics the conflict disappears: probability is carried by the particle ensemble, while the wavefunction guides its motion. The difficulty is then different. What does quantum equilibrium mean when the particle distribution remains normalized but the guiding density does not? We show that the departure has two independent components: a structural one, measured by the Kullback--Leibler divergence between the particle distribution and the normalized guiding density, and an amplitude one, measured by the Born weight. The Born rule holds precisely when both are equilibrated. Their evolution is governed by the complex source-to-wavefunction ratio; scale covariance further distinguishes an independently prescribed source, against which the amplitude of the wave matters, from state-dependent generators for which rescaling remains a symmetry. We develop a source-aware analytical--computational method, combining exact or semi-analytical guiding fields with Bohmian trajectory transport, ensemble quadrature and independent numerical checks. Free-space impulses expose the limits of global diagnostics and an exact jump rule; a driven ring has constant Born weight but either periodic or secular structural departure; oscillators show both source-generated structural change and amplitude-only evolution, including a finite-horizon weak-drive plateau far below its frozen-particle value; and a coupled two-body model exhibits nonlocal guidance and evolving particle entanglement. The source-free, initially equilibrated sector recovers standard quantum mechanics.

AI.tldr: 该文在源扩展的de Broglie–Bohm动力学中提出"量子平衡"的双分量结构：结构分量（粒子分布与归一化导引密度间的KL散度）与幅度分量（Born权重），并给出源感知的解析–计算方法。
AI.motivation: 薛定谔方程中的源项改变导引波范数，表面上违反概率守恒，与标准量子力学冲突；源扩展Bohm动力学虽化解了这一矛盾（概率由粒子系综承载、波函数仅作导引），但留下新问题：粒子分布保持归一而导引密度不归一，"量子平衡"该如何定义。
AI.method: 将偏离分解为两个独立分量：结构分量用粒子分布与归一化导引密度间的Kullback–Leibler散度刻画，幅度分量用Born权重刻画；两者演化由复的"源–波函数比"支配；借助标度协变性区分独立预设源（波幅有意义）与态依赖生成元（重标度为对称性）。随后发展源感知的解析–数值方法：精确或半解析导引场、Bohm轨迹输运、系综求积与独立数值校验。
AI.result: 自由空间脉冲揭示全局诊断量的局限及一条精确跳跃规则；驱动环上Born权重恒定，但结构偏离或呈周期或呈长期漂移；振子同时展现源生成的结构变化与纯幅度演化，含有限时域弱驱动平台（远低于冻结粒子值）；耦合两体模型表现出非局域导引与演化中的粒子纠缠。
AI.conclusion: Born规则恰在两个分量同时平衡时成立；无源且初始平衡的子空间精确恢复标准量子力学。

title: Self-similar Inequality Dynamics in Biased Competition for a Conserved Resource
summary: In many complex systems the redistribution of a conserved resource can generate strong inequality. Important examples are cities exchanging inhabitants, farms competing for farmland, or agents for wealth in saturated markets. Here we model such systems as agents competing for a fixed total resource, and show that coupling agent extinction to a bias favoring richer agents dynamically amplifies this inequality over time. Drawing on an analogy with emulsions, where droplets compete for a conserved quantity, we introduce a dynamical critical resource size that determines an agent's fate. Crucially, this threshold grows in time, continuously raising the bar for survival and further reinforcing inequality. Increasing the bias strength, we find a transition from a continuous resource concentration towards a winner-takes-all outcome. Furthermore, the case of continuous resource concentration is characterized by a self-similar dynamics accompanied by a power-law or exponential increase in inequality, quantified by the Gini coefficient. We derive these results analytically in a mean-field model and compare them to agent-based simulations, showing excellent agreement.

AI.tldr: 将受资源约束的竞争系统类比乳液液滴，引入随时间增长的"临界资源规模"作为存活阈值，发现与财富偏好耦合的灭绝机制会持续放大不平等，并在偏好强度增大时出现从连续资源集中到"赢家通吃"的转变。
AI.motivation: 城市间人口流动、农场争夺耕地、饱和市场中的财富竞争等复杂系统，都会因守恒资源的再分配而产生强烈不平等。作者希望揭示这种不平等为何会随时间动态放大，而非静态地停留在某一水平。
AI.method: 把系统建模为竞争固定总资源的个体集合，并将个体灭绝与偏向富者的偏差耦合起来；借用乳液中液滴争夺守恒量的类比，定义决定个体命运的动态临界资源规模。采用平均场解析模型推导，并与基于个体的数值模拟对照验证。
AI.result: 临界阈值随时间增长，不断提高生存门槛并进一步强化不平等；增大偏差强度时，系统从连续式资源集中转变为赢家通吃。连续集中情形下呈现自相似动力学，不平等（以基尼系数衡量）呈幂律或指数增长。平均场解析结果与个体模拟高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 不平等并非静态结果，而可由"阈值随时间上升+富者偏好"的正反馈机制自发放大；该机制可用简洁的平均场理论精确刻画，并为理解人口、土地与财富分配中的集中现象提供统一框架。

title: Quantum Geometry Effects in Lattice Dynamics
summary: Quantum geometric effects such as the Berry curvature and the quantum metric are well established in electronic transport, whereas in lattice dynamics the Berry curvature also plays a key role: adiabatically following the lattice, electrons generate a molecular Berry curvature that splits degenerate optical phonons into chiral partners. To determine how the quantum metric affects phonons, we go beyond adiabatic lattice dynamics, identifying Berry curvature and quantum metric contributions to the electronic response of the lattice. Using first-principles calculations in the magnetic topological semimetal EuB$_6$, we find that phonon modes with chiral splitting and those with nonchiral splitting coexist. Unlike the former, which originate from the Berry curvature, the latter arise from the pure quantum metric, while the Berry curvature contribution is forbidden by crystal symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文超越绝热晶格动力学框架，将Berry曲率与量子度规对电子-晶格响应的贡献分离，并在磁性拓扑半金属EuB6中首次指认纯量子度规驱动的非手性声子劈裂。
AI.motivation: Berry曲率在电子输运中已被充分研究，在晶格动力学中亦通过"分子Berry曲率"导致简并光学声子劈裂为手性伙伴；但量子度规对声子的作用此前未被系统考察，缺乏超越绝热近似的理论描述。
AI.method: 在绝热晶格动力学之外，推导电子对晶格响应的Berry曲率项与量子度规项；结合第一性原理计算，在磁性拓扑半金属EuB6中识别各声子模劈裂的几何来源，并利用晶体对称性判断各项是否被禁戒。
AI.result: EuB6中手性劈裂与非手性劈裂声子模共存：前者源于Berry曲率；后者源于纯量子度规项，而其Berry曲率贡献被晶体对称性禁戒。
AI.conclusion: 量子度规可作为独立于Berry曲率的晶格动力学几何效应，导致可观测的声子劈裂（非手性），为声子谱中区分两类量子几何贡献提供了判据与新自由度。

title: Strain-induced non-trivial band topology and large magnetoresistance in epitaxial SrTaO$_3$ thin films
summary: Epitaxial thin films of complex transition metal oxides constitute an ideal platform for realizing correlated topological phases through strain engineering of crystal symmetry and band topology. Here, we investigate the electronic transport properties and the band structure of the 5$d^1$ paramagnetic metal SrTaO$_3$ thin film under epitaxial compressive strain. The film exhibits a large non-saturating quasi-quadratic magnetoresistance (MR) and a nonlinear Hall effect characteristic of two-band transport, together with the field induced re-entrant metallic behavior. The violation of Kohler's scaling further corroborates the scattering from multiple bands. Semiclassical two-band analysis yields carrier densities and mobilities of the order $\sim 10^{21}~\mathrm{cm^{-3}}$ and $\sim 10^{4}~\mathrm{cm^2 V^{-1} s^{-1}}$, respectively. The observed large mobility and unsaturated MR, indicates the presence of a non-trivial band structure. Consistent with this, results from density functional theory calculations and tight binding model studies reveal that the stable structure has an octahedral rotation $a^0a^0c^+$, where the non-symmorphic symmetry ensures the presence of topological nodal lines yielding finite Berry curvature in the vicinity of the Fermi level. Besides the nodal line, trivial electron and hole pockets exist near the Fermi level, contributing to electron transport. These findings establish that epitaxial strain drives SrTaO$_3$ into a nontrivial topological semimetal, a phase inaccessible in the bulk counterpart.

AI.tldr: 外延压应变下的SrTaO3薄膜表现出大非饱和准二次磁阻与非线性霍尔效应，结合DFT与紧束缚计算揭示其具有由非简单空间群保证的拓扑节点线，从而把体相中不存在的拓扑半金属相通过应变工程实现出来。
AI.motivation: 探索通过外延应变调控5d过渡金属氧化物的晶格对称性与能带拓扑，在薄膜平台实现体相无法获得的关联拓扑相。
AI.method: 对受压应变的5d^1顺磁金属SrTaO3外延薄膜进行电输运测量（磁阻、霍尔、Kohler定标检验），并做半经典双带模型拟合提取载流子浓度与迁移率；同时结合密度泛函理论计算与紧束缚模型分析稳定结构与能带拓扑。
AI.result: 薄膜呈现大且不饱和的准二次磁阻、双带特征的非线性霍尔效应以及场诱导的再入金属行为；Kohler定标被违背，支持多带散射。双带分析给出载流子浓度约10^21 cm^-3、迁移率约10^4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1。DFT与紧束缚计算表明稳定结构为a^0a^0c^+八面体旋转，非简单空间群对称性保证费米能级附近存在拓扑节点线并产生有限Berry曲率，同时费米面附近还有平庸电子与空穴口袋参与输运。
AI.conclusion: 外延压应变可将SrTaO3驱动为拓扑非平庸半金属，该相在体相材料中无法获得，说明应变工程是实现5d氧化物拓扑半金属态的有效途径。

title: Quantum nonclassicality as a marginal problem
summary: Classical explanations of quantum statistics---local, noncontextual, or causal---fail for one and the same reason: the probability distributions observed in different contexts are not the marginals of a single joint distribution. Every single context admits a classical model. This is Boole's problem of the "conditions of possible experience." Garg and Mermin treated it as a linear problem and showed, via Farkas's lemma, that its solvability is equivalent to a finite list of Bell-type inequalities, one for each extreme ray of a convex polyhedral cone; Pitowsky gave it the form of correlation polytopes. We sketch this common structure and discuss two examples: Aerts's elastic-band model, which reproduces the quantum cosine in one context but obeys the classical bound when contexts are combined; and nonclassicality in causal data fusion, where the contexts are supplied by interventions on a causal structure.

AI.tldr: 该文指出，局部性、非语境性与因果性这三类经典解释的失效有共同根源：不同语境下的概率分布不是同一联合分布的边缘分布；即每个语境单独可经典建模，但联合可解性构成Boole"可能经验条件"问题。作者用Garg–Mermin的线性规划视角（Farkas引理、Bell型不等式、极射线）与Pitowsky的关联多面体统一刻画该结构，并以Aerts弹性带模型和因果数据融合中的非经典性为例。
AI.motivation: 经典解释（局部隐变量、非语境隐变量、因果模型）在量子统计上各自失败，文献中常被当作彼此独立的否定性结论处理；作者希望揭示三者失效的统一数学机制，从而给出一个共同的问题框架与判据语言。
AI.method: 概念性与结构性分析：将各语境的可观测分布集合视为线性可行性问题（Boole"可能经验条件"），借助Farkas引理把可解性等价于有限个Bell型不等式（即凸多面体锥每条极射线对应一个不等式），并以Pitowsky的关联多面体形式表述；随后以Aerts弹性带模型（单语境复现量子余弦、语境合并后服从经典界）和因果结构干预所给语境下的数据融合两个例子进行说明。
AI.result: 论证三类经典解释的失效可归约为同一线性可行性问题，其不可解性由对应凸锥的极射线（Bell型不等式）刻画；Aerts弹性带模型表明单语境经典可实现并不保证跨语境联合可实现，因果数据融合中干预所提供的语境同样呈现同型非经典性。
AI.conclusion: 量子统计的非经典性不必按"局部/非语境/因果"分别理解，而应统一表述为边缘分布不具备单一联合分布（可能经验条件不可解）；Garg–Mermin–Pitowsky 的线性规划—多面体框架提供了统一判据，并自然推广至因果干预语境。

title: Anatomy of orbital and spin responses in GaAs and Si: Hall, inverse Faraday, and magneto-optical Kerr effects
summary: Magneto-optical signals in nonmagnetic semiconductors entangle spin and orbital contributions, both in angular-momentum generation and magneto-optical detection. We calculate these contributions for electron-doped GaAs and Si using density-functional theory, linear-response theory, and a second-order density-matrix treatment of the inverse Faraday effect. At small electron doping, the intrinsic orbital Hall conductivity exceeds its spin counterpart in magnitude, while the orbital contribution to light-induced magnetization dominates over broad photon-energy ranges. We show that orbital- and spin-resolved optical Hall and polar Kerr coefficients exhibit stronger sensitivity to orbital moments than to equal spin moments. This contrast reflects direct electric-dipole coupling to orbital motion versus spin-orbit-mediated coupling to spin polarization. Consequently, Si maintains a substantial orbital magneto-optical response despite its weak spin-orbit interaction. At probe energies of 1.5 eV in GaAs and 3.0 eV in Si, the magnitude of the Kerr rotation per unit orbital moment is approximately 5 and 13 times larger than that per unit spin moment, respectively. Combining the calculated Hall conductivities and Kerr coefficients with a phenomenological drift-diffusion model yields predominantly orbital edge signals for the assumed diffusion constants and relaxation lengths. These results indicate that optical detection of induced magnetization in doped semiconductors such as GaAs and Si can be dominated by orbital signals, and therefore cannot be interpreted solely in terms of spin polarization.

AI.tldr: 用DFT、线性响应与二阶密度矩阵方法计算电子掺杂GaAs和Si中自旋与轨道对磁光信号的贡献，发现小掺杂下轨道霍尔电导及光致磁化以轨道贡献为主，且Kerr旋转对轨道矩更敏感。
AI.motivation: 非磁性半导体中的磁光信号同时包含自旋与轨道角动量贡献，既有角动量产生也有磁光探测环节，二者纠缠导致实验常把信号简单归因于自旋极化，缺乏定量区分。
AI.method: 对电子掺杂GaAs与Si，采用密度泛函理论、线性响应理论，以及处理逆法拉第效应的二阶密度矩阵方法，计算自旋与轨道分辨的光学霍尔电导、极向Kerr系数，并结合唯象漂移-扩散模型模拟边缘信号。
AI.result: 小电子掺杂下本征轨道霍尔电导在数值上超过自旋霍尔电导；光致磁化在较宽光子能量范围内由轨道贡献主导。轨道与自旋分辨的光学霍尔及极向Kerr系数对轨道矩的敏感性高于等量自旋矩：GaAs在1.5 eV探测能下单位轨道矩的Kerr旋转约为单位自旋矩的5倍，Si在3.0 eV下约为13倍；Si虽自旋-轨道耦合弱，仍保持可观轨道磁光响应。结合计算的电导与Kerr系数及漂移-扩散模型，在假设的扩散常数与弛豫长度下边缘信号以轨道为主。
AI.conclusion: 掺杂半导体（如GaAs、Si）中光诱导磁化的光学探测可能由轨道信号主导，不能仅用自旋极化来解释；该对比源于电偶极直接耦合轨道运动，而自旋极化需经自旋-轨道耦合间接耦合。

title: Magneto-ARPES as a direct probe of Berry Curvature and the Orbital Magnetic Moment
summary: The Berry curvature and orbital magnetic moment are central to the understanding of electronic transport phenomena such as the anomalous Hall effect, yet measuring these quantities directly with momentum resolution remains experimentally challenging. Here we show that angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy measurements in a weak magnetic field (magneto-ARPES) provide a direct route to both quantities. We develop an analytic theory of photoemission in a weak magnetic field and show that, for any material, the first-order change in photoemission intensity is directly proportional to both the Berry curvature and the orbital magnetic moment, even in the presence of self-energy effects. For linearly polarised light, the matrix elements are unchanged to first order in the field, so the intensity change directly reflects these quantities. Using monolayer WSe$_2$ as an example, we show how both quantities can be extracted in a typical experiment. This finding thus points to magneto-ARPES as a general route for measuring the momentum-resolved Berry curvature and orbital magnetic moment in quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 该文提出弱磁场下的角分辨光电子能谱（magneto-ARPES）可作为普适手段，直接测量动量分辨的贝里曲率与轨道磁矩：解析理论表明光电子强度的场致一阶变化正比于这两个量，线偏振光下矩阵元在一阶不变，以单层WSe₂为例给出提取方案。
AI.motivation: 贝里曲率与轨道磁矩是理解反常霍尔效应等输运现象的核心量，但迄今缺乏动量分辨的直接测量手段，实验上极具挑战。
AI.method: 建立弱磁场下光电子发射的解析理论，推导光电子强度随磁场的展式；论证一阶强度变化正比于贝里曲率与轨道磁矩，并讨论自能效应与线偏振光下矩阵元的贡献；以单层WSe₂为模型体系给出实验提取流程。
AI.result: 对任意材料，光电子强度的一阶场致变化普遍正比于贝里曲率与轨道磁矩之和，且该结论在包含自能修正时依然成立；采用线偏振光时矩阵元在一阶磁场下不变，故强度变化直接反映上述两个物理量；在单层WSe₂中可同时提取二者。
AI.conclusion: magneto-ARPES为量子材料中动量分辨的贝里曲率与轨道磁矩测量提供了一条通用途径。

title: Revealing the Hidden Symmetry of the Asymmetric Quantum Rabi Model
summary: A longitudinal bias breaks ordinary parity in the asymmetric quantum Rabi model, yet exact crossings reappear when the bias equals an integer multiple $m$ of the oscillator energy spacing. We trace the hidden symmetry to exchange between equal-energy partners $m$ rungs apart on two displaced oscillator ladders. Tunneling to other rungs makes this exchange vary in time. We construct the exact symmetry operator by adding spin and oscillator coherences that cancel this variation. At nonzero coupling and tunneling, the resulting charge has no zero modes, and its sign divides the full Hilbert space into two generalized-parity sectors that cannot mix. Spin-resolved mirror interference probes coherence between the two opposite-parity states at a crossing. Its small-displacement exponent gives $m$, and its leading coefficient, together with the charge magnitude, predicts the mixing induced by a slight change in bias.

AI.tldr: 该文用"隐藏对称性"解释非对称量子Rabi模型中偏置为整数倍m时重新出现的能级交叉，并构造出精确守恒荷，将希尔伯特空间划分为互不混合的两个广义宇称扇区。
AI.motivation: 纵向偏置破坏非对称量子Rabi模型的普通宇称对称性，但当偏置等于振子能级间距的整数倍m时又出现精确交叉。既有研究缺少对对称性来源及交叉结构统一、精确的刻画，作者希望找到交叉背后的隐藏对称性及其守恒量。
AI.method: 将对称性追溯到两条位移振子阶梯上相距m级的等能配对之间的交换；由于隧穿到其他阶梯级使该交换随时间变化，作者通过叠加自旋与振子相干项来抵消这一变化，从而构造精确的对称性算符（守恒荷）；并在非零耦合与隧穿下分析其零模结构，同时对自旋分辨的镜像干涉进行解析计算。
AI.result: 在非零耦合与隧穿下，所得守恒荷不存在零模，其符号将整个希尔伯特空间分成两个不可混合的广义宇称扇区；自旋分辨的镜像干涉可探测交叉点处两个相反宇称态之间的相干性，其小位移极限的幂次指数给出m，而首项系数结合守恒荷大小可预测偏置微小变化所引起的混合。
AI.conclusion: 整数倍偏置下的精确交叉源于阶梯间交换的隐藏对称性，该对称性可由含自旋-振子相干修正的精确守恒荷实现，并给出广义宇称扇区的严格划分与可观测的干涉判据（指数给出m、系数预测微扰混合）。

title: Edge-asymmetric magnetism in semi-Dirac quantum dots
summary: In this study, we investigated the electronic and magnetic properties of quantum dots (QDs) throughout the transition from the Dirac limit to the semi-Dirac limit and beyond. When non-interacting semi-Dirac fermions are confined in triangular QDs, the resulting electronic states near the Fermi level are localized asymmetrically among the three edges of these systems. In the presence of electron interactions, we show that these low-energy states favor the formation of edge-asymmetric magnetism in triangular QDs. In particular, the magnetic moments were localized only along a single edge of the zigzag triangular QDs, corresponding to an edge-asymmetric ferromagnetic ground state. For various system sizes, these zigzag triangular QDs exhibit a one-unit increase in the ground-state total spin ($ΔS_z = +1$) beyond the semi-Dirac limit, revealing a striking result of this transition. In contrast, the remaining two edges are antiferromagnetically coupled in the armchair triangular QDs, indicating an edge-asymmetric antiferromagnetic (AFM) ground state. We further identified the AFM ground states in hexagonal QDs, indicating that these types of asymmetric configurations are not unique to triangular QDs. Collectively, edge-asymmetric magnetism could create potential opportunities for future spintronics.

AI.tldr: 该文研究三角/六边形量子点中从Dirac极限到半Dirac极限及更远处的电子与磁性质，发现受限半Dirac费米子的低能态在三条边上非对称局域，电子相互作用下形成边非对称磁基态（锯齿三角为边非对称铁磁，扶手椅三角为边非对称反铁磁，六边形亦出现反铁磁基态）。
AI.motivation: 探究半Dirac费米子在受限几何中的行为及其相互作用效应，填补Dirac—半Dirac转变过程中量子点磁性的认识空白，并为自旋电子学寻找边非对称磁性的实现途径。
AI.method: 将非相互作用半Dirac费米子限制在三角与六边形量子点中，计算费米面附近的电子态空间分布；再引入电子相互作用，比较锯齿型与扶手椅型三角量子点及六边形量子点的基态自旋构型，并在多个体系尺寸下考察基态总自旋变化。
AI.result: 半Dirac极限下低能态在三条边上非对称局域；相互作用下锯齿三角量子点磁矩仅沿单一锯齿边局域，形成边非对称铁磁基态；扶手椅三角量子点中其余两边反铁磁耦合，形成边非对称反铁磁基态；锯齿三角量子点在跨越半Dirac极限时基态总自旋整体增加一单位（ΔS_z=+1），且该现象在多种尺寸下稳定；六边形量子点亦存在反铁磁基态。
AI.conclusion: 边非对称磁性是半Dirac量子点受限体系的普遍特征而非三角几何所独有，锯齿三角量子点在半Dirac极限之外出现ΔS_z=+1的基态自旋跃变，这类边非对称磁构型可为自旋电子学器件提供潜在应用。

title: Self-consistent Floquet theory of steady-state ordering in driven open systems
summary: Periodically driven open systems have quasienergy bands whose steady-state occupations are set by the drive and reservoir. We formulate a self-consistent Floquet spectral theory of electronic ordering in the weak-reservoir-coupling limit, expressing the nonlinear mean-field equation and the particle-hole response in terms of quasienergies, steady-state occupations, and harmonic matrix elements that account for micromotion. We illustrate the theory in the square-lattice Hubbard model and show how the drive produces `dynamical nesting' conditions and how Floquet resonances produce \textit{hysteretic} responses due to multiple self-consistent solutions. Interestingly, we find that the hysteresis branches exhibit distinct Floquet topologies. Away from half-filling, we find that the combination of drive-induced detuning of the van Hove saddle points and the micromotion leads to the onset of switching between competing incommensurate orders.

AI.tldr: 该文建立了弱储库耦合极限下周期驱动开放系统中电子有序的自洽Floquet谱理论，以准能带、稳态占据与含微运动的谐波矩阵元表述非线性平均场方程与粒子-空穴响应，并在方晶格Hubbard模型中揭示了驱动诱导的"动力学嵌套"、Floquet共振导致的滞回响应及其不同Floquet拓扑分支，以及非半满时非公度序之间的切换。
AI.motivation: 周期驱动开放系统的稳态占据由驱动与储库共同决定，现有理论缺乏一个能同时处理准能带谱结构、稳态非平衡占据与微运动（micromotion）效应的自洽框架，难以描述驱动下电子有序的形成与竞争。
AI.method: 在弱储库耦合极限下构建自洽Floquet谱理论：将非线性平均场方程与粒子-空穴响应函数用准能量、稳态占据数及包含微运动的谐波矩阵元表示；以方晶格Hubbard模型为范例进行具体求解与分析。
AI.result: 驱动产生"动力学嵌套"（dynamical nesting）条件；Floquet共振因存在多个自洽解而给出滞回响应，且不同滞回分支具有不同的Floquet拓扑；偏离半满时，驱动引起的van Hove鞍点失谐与微运动共同导致竞争性非公度有序之间的切换。
AI.conclusion: Floquet谱结构（准能带、非平衡占据、谐波矩阵元）可自洽地决定驱动开放系统中的电子有序，并可产生滞回、拓扑分支分化与非公度序切换等纯平衡态中不存在的现象。

title: Phase-dependent atomicity and PPT edge states for cyclic-sign covariant qutrit maps
summary: Decomposable positive maps cannot detect entangled states with positive partial transpose (PPT). We obtain a necessary and sufficient criterion for decomposability in the entire seven-real-parameter class of Hermiticity-preserving cyclic-sign covariant maps on $M_3$. The criterion reduces to a one-variable inequality and, for positive maps in this class, characterizes indecomposability exactly. We apply it to a phase-dependent family obtained by adding a completely positive map to the Choi map. Every map in this family is positive, and we find the exact phase-dependent threshold for indecomposability and atomicity. At three phase values, the maps remain indecomposable for every finite deformation strength. Each indecomposable map gives an indecomposable entanglement witness through its Choi matrix. We construct PPT edge states of birank $(5,5)$ detected by these witnesses throughout the indecomposable region.

AI.tldr: 给出 M_3 上七实参数 Hermiticity 保持循环符号协变映射类分解性的充要判据（化为一元不等式），并据此确定 Choi 映射加完全正映射的相位依赖族的不可分解与原子性阈值，构造双秩 (5,5) 的 PPT 边界纠缠态。
AI.motivation: 可分解正映射无法探测 PPT 纠缠态，因此需要判定正映射何时不可分解。作者希望在一个结构良好、参数空间完整的大类中给出精确、可操作的分解性判据，并用它刻画具体族的不可分解区域。
AI.method: 在 M_3 上取 Hermiticity 保持、循环符号协变的全部七实参数映射类，将可分解性等价转化为一个单变量不等式，得到充要条件；再研究由 Choi 映射加一个完全正映射构成的相位依赖族，解析求取不可分解与原子性的相位依赖阈值；通过 Choi 矩阵构造纠缠见证，并结合双秩 (5,5) PPT 边界态检验探测能力。
AI.result: 获得七参数类的可分解性充要判据（一元不等式），对正映射恰好刻画不可分解性；新族的每个映射均为正，给出精确的相位依赖不可分解与原子性阈值；在三个相位值处映射对任意有限形变强度都保持不可分解；相应见证在整个不可分解区域探测到双秩 (5,5) PPT 边界态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了 M_3 上循环符号协变映射分解性的完整判定工具，并显示 Choi 映射的完全正形变在特定相位下无法通过有限强度恢复可分解性，同时给出可用的纠缠见证与 PPT 边界态实例。

title: Scanning nanowire quantum dot with radio-frequency read-out
summary: Scanning single-electron transistors (SETs) are highly sensitive local probes of charge and electric potential, but their integration with robust height control for scanning probe microscopy remains challenging. Furthermore, readout bandwidths are limited to tens of kHz, while characterizing faster charge dynamics is often of interest. Here, we present a scanning SET in the form of a nanowire (NW) quantum dot (QD) integrated at the apex of a non-contact atomic force microscopy (NC-AFM) cantilever. We demonstrate NC-AFM topographic imaging and local electrometry capability by mapping the electrostatic potential generated by a set of nanoscale voltage-biased gate electrodes. Comparison with electrostatic simulations shows agreement with the measured potential profiles. We demonstrate radio-frequency (rf) reflectometry read-out of the sensor, by embedding the QD in an LC-resonator. This platform establishes a route towards high-bandwidth scanning electrometry with simultaneous topographic contrast.

AI.tldr: 作者将纳米线量子点单电子晶体管集成于非接触原子力显微镜探针尖端，实现形貌成像与局域电势面分布测量，并通过LC谐振电路实现射频反射读出，为高带宽扫描静电测量提供平台。
AI.motivation: 扫描单电子晶体管（SET）是灵敏的局域电荷与电势探针，但其与扫描探针显微术的稳健高度控制难以兼容整合；同时读出带宽仅数十kHz，难以表征更快的电荷动力学。
AI.method: 构建纳米线（NW）量子点（QD）形式的扫描SET，集成在非接触原子力显微镜（NC-AFM）悬臂尖端；利用其进行NC-AFM形貌成像与局域静电测量，对一组纳米尺度偏压栅电极产生的静电势进行成像，并与静电仿真对比；将量子点嵌入LC谐振回路，实现射频（rf）反射读出。
AI.result: 成功实现NC-AFM形貌成像与局域电势面分布映射，测得电势剖面与静电仿真结果相符；演示了量子点经LC谐振嵌入后的射频反射读出。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为兼具形貌衬度的高带宽扫描静电测量建立了可行路径。

title: Quantum and classical transport in the underscreened Kondo lattice
summary: We investigate quantum effects in high-spin Kondo-lattice transport as resistivity approaches the classical spin-disorder limit. Using dynamical mean-field theory and the numerical renormalization group, we calculate resistivity, the Seebeck coefficient, and optical conductivity for the paramagnetic single-channel Kondo lattice away from half filling. At intermediate temperatures, the resistivity for large local spin $S$ approaches the double-exchange plateau. Thermopower retains a positive quantum excess even where resistivity is nearly classical. The excess arises from the transport kernel's particle-hole asymmetry. Even the full Kelvin approximation, often accurate for incoherent correlated metals, captures only part of it. Incomplete Kondo screening leaves residual moments and leads to singular Fermi-liquid behavior at low temperatures. For $S=1$, the apparent power-law resistivity is consistent with a $1/\ln^2(T_ρ/T)$ asymptote. Above the Kondo scale $T_K$, weak-coupling resistivity follows $1/\ln^2(T/T_K)$. Above the band and exchange scales, the charge susceptibility decreases as $1/T$, while the effective diffusion constant becomes nearly temperature independent, resulting in linear resistivity. A many-body coherent-potential approximation accounts for the spin dependence of the linear coefficient without adjustable parameters.

AI.tldr: 该文用DMFT+NRG研究非半满顺磁单通道Kondo晶格在接近经典自旋无序极限时的大自旋输运，指出热电势存在正量子超额、低温呈奇异费米液体行为、高温电阻率线性。
AI.motivation: 检验高自旋Kondo晶格在电阻率趋于经典自旋无序极限（双交换平台）时是否仍保留量子效应，并厘清输运核粒子-空穴不对称性对热电势的贡献及Kelvin近似的适用边界。
AI.method: 采用动力学平均场理论（DMFT）结合数值重整化群（NRG），计算非半满、顺磁、单通道Kondo晶格的电阻率、Seebeck系数与光电导；并借助多体相干势近似（CPA）解析自旋依赖的线性系数。
AI.result: 中等温度下大自旋S的电阻率趋近双交换平台；热电势在电阻率近乎经典时仍保留正量子超额，源于输运核的粒子-空穴不对称，完整Kelvin近似仅能捕捉部分；低温因Kondo屏蔽不完全留下残余磁矩，呈奇异费米液体行为，S=1时表观幂律与1/ln²(T_ρ/T)渐近一致；T_K以上弱耦合区电阻率随1/ln²(T/T_K)；高于能带与交换尺度时电荷磁化率按1/T下降、有效扩散常数近乎不依赖温度，导致线性电阻率；多体CPA无需可调参数即可解释线性系数的自旋依赖。
AI.conclusion: 即使电阻率趋于经典极限，高自旋Kondo晶格输运仍含显著量子修正；热电势超额与各温区的标度行为可由输运核不对称及屏蔽不完全统一解释，多体CPA给出无参数的自旋依赖描述。

title: Many-Body Flux Selection in Chiral Quantum Batteries
summary: We study an interacting quantum-battery chain in which a synthetic flux controls interference between hopping paths. Keeping the internal battery Hamiltonian fixed, we seek the flux that leaves the most extractable work. Even a Gaussian reconstruction supplied with exact one-body information can rank competing flux settings incorrectly. A reduced many-body model that retains correlations within a few battery-occupation sectors recovers the correct ranking and selects nearly optimal fluxes across the finite systems and parameter ranges studied. Strikingly, the model can make an accurate control choice even when it excludes configurations carrying substantial probability in the exact state. Thus, choosing a nearly optimal charging flux can require much less information than reconstructing the full many-body state.

AI.tldr: 在相互作用量子电池链中，调控合成磁通以最大化可提取功；基于单体积信息的Gaussian重构可能错误排序磁通设定，而仅保留少数占据子空间关联的约化多体模型能正确排序并选出近最优磁通。
AI.motivation: 保持电池内部哈密顿量固定、以外加合成磁通调控跳跃路径干涉，从而在不改变体系本征能量的前提下最大化可提取功；并探究实现这种近最优控制究竟需要多少多体信息。
AI.method: 构建含相互作用的一维量子电池链，以合成磁通调控跃迁路径干涉；对比两类预测手段：一是利用精确单体（单粒子）信息做Gaussian重构，二是构造只保留少数电池占据数扇区内关联的约化多体模型，并在有限体系与参数范围内评估其对磁通的排序与选择能力。
AI.result: 即使Gaussian重构拥有精确的单体信息，仍会错误地对竞争磁通设定排序；约化多体模型在所研究的有限体系与参数范围内恢复正确排序并选出近最优磁通；更引人注目的是，该模型在排除掉精确态中占有显著概率的构型时，仍能给出准确的控制选择。
AI.conclusion: 选择近最优充电磁通所需的信息远少于重构完整多体态；针对任务定制的约化多体描述可替代全态重构，为量子电池及类似量子控制问题提供更经济有效的决策途径。

title: Local redundancies are necessary for long-lived memories in finite spatial dimensions
summary: We prove a no-go theorem for exponentially long-lived thermal memories, based on the structure of redundancies among Hamiltonian terms. For local stabilizer Hamiltonians in finite spatial dimensions, the absence of local redundancies---relations in which the product of a small number of Hamiltonian terms equals the identity---is known to preclude bulk thermodynamic phase transitions. Yet glassy dynamics can still sustain long-lived memories even without a thermodynamic transition, as demonstrated by LDPC codes on non-Euclidean graphs. A longstanding question, exemplified by Haah's cubic code, is whether such a mechanism can also support passive (quantum) memory in finite-dimensional Euclidean systems. We show that this route fails for local stabilizer Hamiltonians without local redundancies: at any constant nonzero temperature, local heat-bath dynamics is fast mixing, with $O(N)$ mixing time, where $N$ is the number of qubits. We establish this by proving a strong decay of correlations property of the thermal Gibbs state. We further prove rapid mixing with $O(\log N)$ mixing time under a stronger condition on induced redundancies in suitably chosen regions. This stronger result applies to several well-studied examples, including Haah's cubic code and its generalizations, as well as three-dimensional layer codes. Our work identifies redundancy structure as a key property for understanding thermal memories.

AI.tldr: 论文基于哈密顿量项之间冗余关系的结构，证明了指数长寿命热存储器的不可能性（no-go）定理：对无局域冗余的有限维局域稳定子哈密顿量，任何常数非零温度下热浴动力学快速混合（O(N)），并进一步在更强条件下给出 O(log N) 混合时间，覆盖Haah立方码及其推广与三维层码。
AI.motivation: 局域稳定子哈密顿量若缺少局域冗余，则已知无法产生体相热力学相变；但非欧几里得图上的LDPC码表明玻璃态动力学可在无相变时仍维持长寿命存储。由此引出核心问题：这种机制能否在有限维欧氏系统中支撑被动（量子）存储，Haah立方码即为长期悬而未决的典型例子。作者希望从冗余结构角度给出统一判据。
AI.method: 以哈密顿量项间冗余（少量项的乘积等于恒等的关系）结构为出发点，证明局域冗余缺失情形下热Gibbs态具有强关联衰减性质，并据此用热浴动力学论证快速混合；在所选区域中诱导冗余满足更强条件时，进一步推出更快的混合时间尺度。
AI.result: 对无局域冗余的有限维局域稳定子哈密顿量，证明该路线失败：任意常数非零温度下局域热浴动力学快速混合，混合时间为O(N)（N为量子比特数）。在对诱导冗余更强的条件下，证明混合时间为O(log N)。后者适用于多个研究充分的实例，包括Haah立方码及其推广，以及三维层码。
AI.conclusion: 冗余结构是理解热存储的关键性质：无局域冗余的局域稳定子模型无法在有限维欧氏系统中实现指数长寿命的被动量子存储，Haah型玻璃态机制不能作为热存储方案。

title: All-in-one Spintronic Sensory Neurons for Magnetic Edge Intelligence
summary: Magnetic fields enable non-contact sensing through nonmagnetic materials, offering opportunities for magnetic edge intelligence in autonomous recognition, navigation, and control. However, directly converting magnetic stimuli into neural spikes for local neuromorphic processing remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate an all-in-one spintronic sensory neuron (SSN) based on spin-transfer-torque magnetic tunnel junctions (STT-MTJs) fabricated using a 40-nm magnetoresistive random-access memory (MRAM) process. By exploiting magnetic-field-modulated stochastic switching, the SSN enables probability-based sensing with an electrically tunable sensitive field window, allowing adaptive operation across different magnetic-field ranges without structural modification. This tunability alleviates the fixed sensitivity-range constraint of conventional tunneling magnetoresistance sensing, providing an accessible sensing range of +/-40 mT with an average probability sensitivity of 2.91%/mT. Importantly, the same stochastic switching process directly transduces magnetic stimuli into binary spike trains, integrating magnetic sensing, nonlinear rate encoding, and spike generation within a single nanoscale device. The resulting sigmoidal spike-rate response enables magnetic-field encoding, experimentally validated using the Neural Engineering Framework. Using experimentally characterized device responses, a simulated 10 x 10 SSN array achieves 90.7% accuracy in contactless magnetic-trajectory recognition with optimized encoding, approaching the software baseline. These results establish a scalable, MRAM-compatible approach to unifying programmable magnetic sensing and neural encoding for sensor-native edge intelligence.

AI.tldr: 基于40 nm MRAM工艺的STT-MTJ构建一体化自旋电子感觉神经元（SSN），利用磁场调制随机翻转实现概率式磁传感与脉冲编码的融合，并验证了无接触磁轨迹识别。
AI.motivation: 磁场可穿透非磁性材料实现非接触感知，是边缘智能（自主识别、导航、控制）的理想载体；但将磁刺激直接转换为神经脉冲以供本地神经形态处理仍具挑战，且传统TMR传感的灵敏度—量程固定受限。
AI.method: 采用40 nm MRAM工艺制备STT-MTJ，利用磁场调制下的随机翻转（stochastic switching）实现概率式传感，通过电学调节敏感磁场窗口；同一随机翻转过程将磁刺激直接转译为二值脉冲序列，实现磁传感、非线性速率编码与脉冲产生的一体化；器件响应经实验表征后，用Neural Engineering Framework验证编码，并以实测响应构建10×10 SSN阵列仿真进行无接触磁轨迹识别。
AI.result: 可实现±40 mT的可用传感范围，平均概率灵敏度2.91%/mT，且敏感窗口可电学调谐而无需改变结构；脉冲发放率呈S形（sigmoidal）响应，可用于磁场编码并经NEF实验验证；10×10阵列仿真在优化编码下无接触磁轨迹识别准确率达90.7%，接近软件基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种与MRAM工艺兼容、可规模化的方案，将可编程磁传感与神经编码统一于单一纳米器件，为传感器原生（sensor-native）的边缘智能提供了可行路径。

title: Lincege.jl: LINked Cluster Expansions on a GEneral GEometry
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, and 10 tables. Comments are welcomed
summary: The numerical linked-cluster expansion (NLCE) is a powerful tool for studying properties of quantum lattice models directly in the thermodynamic limit. Here, we introduce Lincege.jl, a versatile, efficient, and easy-to-use package for generating the clusters needed to perform the NLCE on a general finite or infinite lattice. Lincege.jl takes as input only the Bravais lattice vectors, the basis information, and the expansion unit and uses a depth-first search to efficiently generate clusters, their lattice constants, and the sub-cluster information. It outputs final coefficients of the series, expressed in terms of the extensive properties of the clusters, in different orders. The package also contains tools for visualizing the lattice and the generated clusters as well as a classical Ising model solver that can be used as a template for interfacing Lincege.jl with solvers of other lattice models. This package can be installed using the Julia package manager and utilized with example scripts from our GitHub repository at https://github.com/rightleftspin/Lincege.jl. The online documentation, including examples, can be found at https://rightleftspin.github.io/Lincege.jl/stable/.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 Lincege.jl，一个基于 Julia 的通用软件包，用于为任意有限或无限晶格自动生成数值链接簇展开（NLCE）所需的簇结构及级数系数。
AI.motivation: NLCE 是直接在热力学极限下研究量子晶格模型性质的有力工具，但为一般晶格高效生成所需簇（及其子簇关系与对称等价信息）通常繁琐且易错，缺乏通用、易用的自动化工具。
AI.method: Lincege.jl 仅需输入 Bravais 晶格矢量、基元信息和展开单元，采用深度优先搜索高效生成簇、其晶格常数与子簇信息；输出以簇的广延量表示的各阶级数系数。包内还提供晶格与簇的可视化工具，以及一个经典 Ising 模型求解器作为对接其他模型求解器的模板。
AI.result: 实现了簇生成、子簇信息提取、级数系数输出、可视化与 Ising 求解示例；可通过 Julia 包管理器安装，GitHub 仓库提供示例脚本，并配有在线文档。
AI.conclusion: Lincege.jl 为 NLCE 提供通用、高效且易用的晶格簇生成框架，降低了对其他模型求解器的接口门槛，便于推广 NLCE 在各类晶格模型研究中的应用。

title: Sharp Purity Based Entropy Bounds and Machine Learning Assisted Entropy Estimation
summary: Purity quantifies quantum-state mixedness, motivating the study of its role in controlling entropy variations. A sharp purity-based continuity bound is established for the von Neumann entropy of qubit states. The bound is attainable for every admissible purity difference and strictly improves the existing purity bound.
